# Borrowed Mirrorball

Disco loop in F major at 120 BPM in 4/4, 32 bars looping as a whole. Its color comes from chords borrowed from F minor: iv B♭m6, ♭VI D♭maj7, and ♭VII E♭.

## Form

| Section | Bars | Chords | What happens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Intro | 1–4 | F pedal | Kick, hats, and octave bass, then claps and shaker from bar 3 |
| Verse | 5–12 | Fmaj7, Am7, B♭maj7, B♭m6, then Fmaj7, Dm7, Gm7, E♭9 | Strings and a low lead (C4–B♭4) enter, then congas and stabs from bar 9 |
| Chorus | 13–20 | B♭maj7, Am7, D♭maj7, E♭6, then Fmaj7, Dm9, B♭m6, C7 | Lead lifts to C5–A5; tambourine and 16th hats; stabs anticipate the next chord |
| Break | 21–24 | D♭maj7, E♭6, D♭maj7, E♭6 | Kick, claps, and lead out with stop-time stabs; the whole kit drops in bar 24 |
| Chorus 2 | 25–32 | Same as the chorus | Full band plus a flute countermelody; bar 32 beat 4 is pulled into the loop |

## Tracks

| Track | Part |
| --- | --- |
| Drums | Four-on-the-floor, offbeat hats, claps on 2 and 4 |
| Percussion tops | Shaker, congas, tambourine |
| Octave bass | Alternating root octaves on 8ths |
| String ostinato | 8th-note figure on upper chord tones |
| Chord stabs | Short hits on 2-and and 4-and |
| Lead | Syncopated hook |
| Countermelody | Descending line from D6 in chorus 2 |

## Groove

- Lead phrases start on 1-and or 2-and and land on 4-and ahead of the barline.
- The kick drops on beat 4 of bars 12, 20, and 32, with snare rolls before the chorus.
- Layers enter one group at a time at bars 1, 3, 5, 9, 13, and 25.
- Every section boundary falls on the 4-bar grid, so the phrases suit a DJ mix.
